text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. My brain's got a bit of muscle 
soreness, so to speak...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's throbbing... almost like I 
overworked muscles I don't usually use...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Why is this happening...? Is it because I 
studied more than usual just because exams 
are coming up...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Or was it because... I was so curious 
about what happens next in that manga that 
I spent the whole time daydreaming about 
the plot...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Shouting made it hurt again...!

It seems Mejiro Ryan is troubled by a 
headache...
